subject: NovaHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps
summary: Post-call recap and confirmed kickoff plan for a 4-week POC with NovaHealth. Scope: document ingestion + clinical summarization assistant. Success metrics: median generation latency <200ms, 95th pct latency <400ms, throughput 50 req/s, and quality benchmarks >= 92% on provided prompt evals. Owners and access steps listed; next milestone: first eval results due Week 2.

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NovaHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great kickoff. Below is a short recap of the problem, the agreed scope for the pilot, success metrics, owners, and the immediate next steps so everyone is aligned. Please reply with any corrections.

Pain points (from today):
- Clinical team spends ~10-12 hours/day on manual chart summarization and triage prep.
- Existing summarization models are inconsistent with clinical tone and hallucinate medication details.
- Latency in the current in-house endpoint is causing UX issues for live reviewer workflows.

POC scope (4 weeks):
- Ingest: 10k de-identified patient notes (supplied by NovaHealth).
- Feature: Clinical summarization assistant (single-turn + short context QA).
- Integration: Redwood SDK + API key test integration into your staging reviewer tool (no PHI in test environment).
- Eval: Run prompt set of 250 clinical cases (we'll run side-by-side evaluation vs. your current model).

Success metrics (agreed):
- Latency: median generation latency < 200 ms; 95th percentile < 400 ms (for 2k token context).
- Throughput: sustain 50 requests/sec with <2x latency tail increase.
- Quality: >= 92% pass rate on your rubric (precision on medication/details + clinical relevance).
- Cost target: benchmark tokens/throughput to aim for < $0.05 per 1k generated tokens in pilot config.

Owners / roles:
- NovaHealth: Jenna Park (PM) — data & prompt rubric; Carlos Rivera (CTO) — infrastructure access.
- Redwood: Marissa Bennett (AE) — project lead & commercial, Aditya Rao (SE) — onboarding & infra, Rishi Malhotra (SSE) — evals & tuning.

Timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): data access + account provisioning; review SOW and sign DocuSign.
- Week 1: sample ingestion + run baseline evals on your current model.
- Week 2: Redwood runs prompt set, tune quantization/batching config; share interim results.
- Week 3: integration testing in staging; operator handoff.
- Week 4: final eval, readout, and recommendation / next steps (Dedicated vs Hosted).

Access / setup items (action owners):
- Jenna: provide de-identified sample dataset (S3 link) and the prompt rubric by Wed 11/18.
- Carlos: create a service account with read-only S3 access and send the key to aditya_rao@redwood.com (encrypted).
- Marissa: send SOW & DocuSign link (attached) and open HubSpot deal D-89421.
- Aditya: will provision a dedicated test instance and a staging API key; ETA 48 hours after access.

Attachments: POC_SOW_NovaHealth.pdf (SOW), Shared_Prompt_Set.csv (prompt examples).

Thanks — I'll follow up with the DocuSign link and provisioned staging key once Carlos confirms the service account.


Marissa Bennett
